pete-pm: Quick sync 3 embedding-route-specific fallback + A/B cohort plan. Ask: we need a low-impact fallback path for embeddings queries that protects recall for critical tenants and limits cost during regional pressure. Proposal below.

liu-eng: +1. Embeddings have different failure modes vs text gen: small model quant changes can shift vector space and break kNN recall. We should prioritize approaches that preserve index stability. My suggested ordered actions: 1) rate-limit long/expensive queries (top-k / batch size), 2) reduce precision (float32 -> int8) only for non-critical tenants, 3) switch to local approximate index with stale vectors (best-effort), 4) reroute to another region's embedding shard, 5) degrade to cached nearest-neighbor responses (serve from recent snapshot).

pete-pm: Good. Key constraints we discussed with product: no silent recall regressions for paying customers. So VIPs get opt-out to reserved pool or enforced exact-index path. Non-VIP cohorts get the graded fallbacks.

sophia-sre: Safety & telemetry: per-region embed-p99 latency, embed_error_rate (index misses), and mean reciprocal rank (MRR) on a sampled eval set. Auto-trigger when embed_p99 > baseline + 300ms for 2m AND region_gpu_mem_pressure > 80% OR indexing-lag > 30s. Rollback if embed_error_rate > 1% for 5m OR MRR delta > 5% relative. Also record sample request ids and top-10 vectors before/after fallback for offline audit.

jamie-ux: UX notes: we must surface "confidence of recall" in the tenant dashboard and annotate when responses are coming from fallback index vs primary. Also add a short text in SDK responses: "\"served_from\": \"fallback-index\"" for transparency.

cleo-sales: Commercial note: enterprise customers want two protections: (A) business-hours non-fallback (reserved capacity) and (B) consistency SLAs (max MRR drop). We'll need an API to opt a tenant into `embeddings_nonfallback_hours` and a billing flag for reserved pools.

liu-eng: Flag schema draft (region + route scoped):
```
embeddings_fallback_mode: off | monitor | throttle | quantize | local_index | reroute | cache_stub
embeddings_fallback_pct: 0-100
embeddings_exempt_tenants: [tenant_ids]
embeddings_reserved_pool: bool
embeddings_reserved_hours: [TZ-aware windows]
fallback_cooldown_s: 1200
max_fallbacks_per_region_hour: 8
log_snapshot_sample_pct: 0-5
```
We should keep `quantize` limited to offline-evaluated model variants only.

sophia-sre: Canary plan specific to embeddings: start with shadow-only index comparisons for 24h (record top-10 vectors, MRR and latency). Then step: 0.5% traffic throttle -> 2% -> 10% for each fallback action. Each step must run blind evaluation vs baseline on sampled queries. Acceptance thresholds: MRR delta < 1.5% and p99 latency reduction target met. If thresholds fail, stop and collect snapshots. We'll also run an offline A/B where 10% of non-VIP queries are served by fallback index and held for 48h to compare recall.

jamie-ux: For the SDK/API: expose `prefer_stable_index: bool` (default false) and `served_from` in the response. That lets customers opt-in to stable behavior client-side. Document semantics in our API docs.

pete-pm: Launch criteria (MVP):
- Shadow validation 24h with MRR delta < 1% on core eval set
- Canary windows: no customer-visible regressions for VIP cohorts for 72h
- Dashboard queries for embed_p95/p99, MRR, error_rate, and fallback_rate live
- API to set `embeddings_exempt_tenants` and `embeddings_reserved_hours` tested end-to-end
- Runbook with panic button (disable cross-region reroute + force restore from snapshot) written and tested

cleo-sales: Also add a comms template explaining what "served_from: fallback-index" means and billing FAQ for reserved capacity.

sophia-sre: Ops checklist: preflight index consistency tests, kNN recall smoke tests, canary traffic replays, circuit-breaker (stop escalations if more than X falls in Y minutes), and a token-bucket to rate-limit fallback-induced requests. Recommend max_fallbacks_per_region_hour = 8 as a starting point.

liu-eng: A/B experiment idea: for 14 days, randomly assign 10% of standard tenants to an experiment group where fallback quantize path is enabled in low traffic windows and compare long-term recall/usage and cost delta. Capture retention on downstream features that use embeddings (search CTR, rerank acceptance).

jamie-ux: UX acceptance: add an admin view that shows per-tenant fallback history, last fallback time, and a button to request reserved capacity windows. Support needs this for troubleshooting.

pete-pm: Next steps: I'll open PRD + ticket with the flag schema and telemetry panels. Tagging @legal and @sales for reserved-pool language and pricing. Ops/SRE, please validate the cooldowns and thresholds in the sim harness.

alert-bot: deploy scheduled: `rollout/embeddings-fallback/v1` -> canary start 2026-05-02T12:00:00Z (1% us-west, shadow+throttle)

sophia-sre: I'll post the canary acceptance checklist once thresholds are tuned. If anyone else has additional must-haves, drop them here and I'll fold into the runbook.
